03358a790c74: How do I create a quote in Travelife ERP?
7559e154415c: To create a quote in Travelife, open the Sales > Proposals > New quote menu. This manual creation interface lets you design a tailor-made offer by combining different services and adapting each price line to the customer's needs.
550e0b713e30: Issued quotes are then tracked in the Quote list, so you can follow up on proposals awaiting approval. For group travel or a complex project, first use Sales > Quotation to simulate costs and gross margin before issuing the quote. Once accepted, the quote becomes an order in Sales > Sales.
8c408666568b: How do I track the margin on a group trip in Travelife?
ba1c03d11923: Group trip margins are tracked in the Booking Files module (Main Menu > Booking files), designed for group travel (GIT), tours and MICE events.
ce807a2c36bc: Each booking file shows, in real time, the revenue from linked customer orders, gross margin and markup rate, as well as the load factor (for example 3 / 17 seats). Group purchases (accommodation, transport, guide) are entered in the booking file's purchase journal, and an alert flags supplier commitments whose invoice has not yet been recorded. You therefore know the actual profitability of each departure.
57bee9ccfda3: How do I control VAT with Travelife software?
e05b056c7027: VAT control is handled in Accounting / Cash > Accounting > VAT. Travelife produces reports that comply with current regulations (DGI compliance) and separates taxable flows from exempt flows.
6ef8c7082777: The VAT Control report checks VAT collected on sales against payments received, and Supplier VAT Control tracks recoverable VAT on purchase invoices. These reports make it easier to prepare your tax returns. Customer and supplier credit reports, in the same Accounting menu, round out the agency's financial management.
96a246cd1d64: Can Travelife handle services that are not connected via API?
17f317d98d14: Yes. The Sales > Book Offline module lets you manually add services not connected via API, such as local guides, restaurants or small hotels.
a17bd1c99abf: You can enter flights, accommodation, transfers, activities, boats or extras directly in the customer's overall booking file. These offline bookings then appear in the booking list and in Planning, alongside API bookings and direct hotel contracts. Travelife thus centralizes all sources in a single calendar so that no service is overlooked.
